content.title: Happy Easter! See Florida restaurants, fast food open or closed today
content.text: April 5, 2026, 6:01 a.m. ETMany national chain restaurants and fast-food spots will remain open on Easter Sunday.Some restaurants, including Chick-fil-A and Chipotle, are expected to be closed for the holiday.It is recommended to call local restaurants to confirm their specific holiday hours.Happy Easter!Lent, a 40-day season of prayer and fasting observed by Christians before Easter, ended on Holy Thursday, April 2. Today's holiday celebrates the resurrection of Jesus Christ.Whether you want an untouched, pristine kitchen all day or your family just wants to switch things up and go out to eat for the holiday tonight, there are plenty of chain restaurants and fast food joints open on Easter Sunday.Need some help deciding? Here is what is open and closed throughout Florida.When is Easter 2026?Easter Sunday is today, April 5.In 2025, Easter fell much later in the month, on April 20. Eastern Orthodox Easter will fall on Sunday, April 12, 2026.Is Cracker Barrel open on Easter? Restaurants open for 2026 EasterA majority of national chain restaurants will still be open across the state.
